donation_supporters_pseudonym_shape.name: donation_supporters_pseudonym_shape
donation_supporters_pseudonym_shape.value:
"donation_supporters"."pseudonym" IS NULL OR
    (length("donation_supporters"."pseudonym") BETWEEN 3 AND 40 AND "donation_supporters"."pseudonym" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 ._-]*[A-Za-z0-9]$')

donations_verified.name: donations_verified
donations_verified.value:
"donations"."status" NOT IN ('confirmed', 'reversed') OR
    ("donations"."confirmed_atomic" IS NOT NULL AND "donations"."received_at" IS NOT NULL AND "donations"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "donations"."transaction_id" IS NOT NULL)
